snippet.title: Machine Party - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Read more about Machine Party here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4108000/Machine_Party/

Machine Party is a collection of violent party games for 2-4 players, that all have lethal consequences. Releasing late this summer.

Run across minefields, assemble firearms, smoke cigs as fast as possible, dodge trains, eat peas, and try to survive!
